mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 8% for two consecutive months signals weakening consumer demand and earnings pressure, which reduces corporate profit growth and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline in periods where UNRATE > 8.0 for two months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) for two consecutive quarters signals deteriorating demand, which reduces corporate revenue growth and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 declines for two consecutive quarters
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline in periods where GDPC1 declines for two consecutive quarters (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in CPI inflation above 3% for three consecutive months signals tighter monetary policy and higher discount rates, which reduces equity valuations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline in periods where CPIAUCSL > 3% for three months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) above 200,000 for three consecutive months signals robust labor market growth, which boosts earnings expectations and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline in periods where PAYEMS > 200,000 for three months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 600,000 for three consecutive months signals weakening residential investment, which reduces GDP growth and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline in periods where HOUST < 600,000 for three months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 96 for three consecutive months signals weakening manufacturing activity, which reduces earnings growth and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline in periods where INDPRO < 96 for three months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in personal savings (RSAFS) above 400 billion for three consecutive months signals increased precautionary behavior, which reduces consumer spending and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline in periods where RSAFS > 400 billion for three months (t-test p > 0.05).
